method: Three or more fresh-process repeats; variants and cases reverse every second round. All production extensions and footnotes remain enabled. Ordinary-archive timing is the performance comparison; separately instrumented stages identify costs. Source preparation, fingerprints/HTML and destruction are outside parse timing; destruction is reported separately. Memory is OS sampling, not allocation attribution or a leak test. No GUI timing claims.

semantic_oracle_provenance.implementation: Ordinary vendored archive before the footnote fast path

known_original_instability.scope: Encoded caret as the footnote opener is unstable in the frozen original too. Kept separately, not counted as passing. Not fixed by this change.
